name: SO-50
note: A classic first FM contact. It has a 10-minute timer that has to be armed with a short carrier on a separate tone before use. Its signal is weak, so a handheld needs a directional antenna.
noteSource: AMSAT live FM satellites table (https://www.amsat.org/live-fm-satellites/), checked 2026-10-18
amsatStatusSource: AMSAT status page satellite list (https://www.amsat.org/status/), checked 2026-10-19

profile.builtBy: King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST), Saudi Arabia
profile.story: SaudiSat-1C has been relaying FM contacts for more than two decades and is many operators’ first satellite. Its repeater sleeps behind a 10-minute timer that you wake with a short transmission on a separate tone, then it repeats on the normal tone until the timer runs out.
